text: Neuraxis [Gr. neuron , nerve, + axwn , axis]: Ger. Centralnervensystem ; Fr. névraxe , axe cérébrospinal ; Ital. neurasse . The cerebrospinal axis, or central nervous system, including the brain and spinal cord. Other terms used are myelencephalon, neuron, axion. ( H.H. )
